Minimum condition: No calibrated method supports the edge.
Reporting action: Do not display as a discovered relation.

Minimum condition: One method supports the edge in one unit or one specification.
Reporting action: Retain in an audit table; do not emphasize.

Minimum condition: Random Forest predictive family is supported while the linear-model family is not; shadow and forward-fold criteria pass.
Reporting action: Require replication and seed/tuning stability before emphasis; do not call it triangulated.

Minimum condition: Exactly one evidence family (linear-model or nonlinear/predictive) supports the edge and the direction replicates in >=2 units or independent layers.
Reporting action: Report as non-confirmatory, family-specific evidence with its unresolved alternatives.

Minimum condition: Linear-model family (classical and/or Bayesian) AND nonlinear/predictive RF family support the edge; replication, placebo, and sensitivity gates pass.
Reporting action: Report as conservative temporal precedence, not structural causation; accompany with empirical FDP/power calibration.
